    Controller.handleGetLeaderboard(ClientConnection connection, String nickname, int numPlayers)
    Handles the leaderboard request: retrieves matches with the specified number of players and the requester's position from the database, then sends the result to the client.
    void
    Controller.handleJoinGame(String nickname, ClientConnection connection)
    Handles the entry of a client.
    void
    Controller.handleReconnect(String nickname, ClientConnection connection)
    Restores a player who reconnects within the valid time window: removes them from the disconnected list, replaces their VirtualView with that of the new connection, resends the full state snapshot (and the current turn), notifies others of the reentry, and, if the game was suspended with >= 2 active players, resumes it.

    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    RMIClientHandler
    ============================================================================ RMIClientHandler — Handler for an RMI connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Handles RMI requests from a client - Forwards requests to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate via RMI callback) - Manages heartbeat (ping/pong) ============================================================================
    class 
    SocketClientHandler
    ============================================================================ SocketClientHandler — Handler for a TCP connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Separate thread for each client connected via TCP Socket - Reads Requests from the client and forwards them to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate) and ClientHandler - Manages the heartbeat system (ping/pong) to detect disconnections PING-PONG PATTERN: - Ping every 5 seconds (PING_INTERVAL_MS) - If no Pong is received within 15 seconds (PING_TIMEOUT_MS): 1.
